::: {#rem-prediction-mse}
#### Prediction MSE, estimator MSE and RSS

@def-prediction-mse averages squared errors over observations,
where the [mean squared error of an estimator](#def-mse)
takes an expectation over repeated samples.
On the data used to fit the model,
$\prederr_i^2 = \resid_i^2$ (@rem-prediction-error),
so $\mselr{\fitted} = \frac{1}{n} \sumin \resid_i^2$:
the [residual sum of squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-rss)
divided by $n$.
:::
